subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw support a moving-main npm dev dist-tag, or should dev installs remain git-only in docs and tooling?
rationale: The missing selector is confirmed, but enabling it changes supply-chain release automation and credential/provenance boundaries that automation should not choose.

options.title: Retire npm dev selector for now
options.body: Update release-channel, install, update, and release docs so dev is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

options.title: Design npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add a first-class secure publish path with versioning, approvals, provenance, credential boundaries, rollback, tests, and registry readback before enabling openclaw@dev.

options.title: Keep policy undecided
options.body: Leave this issue open as a release-owner decision while existing dev users continue using the git checkout path.

recommendation.title: Retire npm dev selector for now
recommendation.body: Update release-channel, install, update, and release docs so dev is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest prior review and release-doc/workflow history signal for this exact decision surface.
